summary: Magic Tour Highlights is an EP by Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band, released for digital download on July 15, 2008. It contains four live audio tracks and their accompanying videos. The performances were recorded during the 2008 Magic Tour and feature guest musicians, including Danny Federici's last performance with the group.
one_line: Magic Tour Highlights is a 2008 digital EP by Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band of four live tracks recorded on the 2008 Magic Tour.
key_facts: Magic Tour Highlights is an EP by Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band.
The EP consists of four live audio tracks and their accompanying videos.
Magic Tour Highlights was released for digital download on July 15, 2008.
The performances on Magic Tour Highlights were recorded during the 2008 Magic Tour.
Magic Tour Highlights includes Danny Federici's last performance with the E Street Band.
